data.title: Screen Capture Capability
data.summary: The sample periodically captures the screen or a targeted window and saves or exfiltrates the image, typically timed around a target application gaining focus.
data.description:
Screen capture complements rather than replaces keylogging: it recovers content a
keylogger cannot, including on-screen authenticator codes, account balances, and anything
entered via mouse or on-screen keyboard. Implementations range from a timed
BitBlt/PrintWindow call to a trigger tied to a specific window title or process gaining
focus, which produces a much smaller and more targeted set of captures than periodic
polling.
data.recommendation:
* Determine the capture trigger (timer vs. focus-change) — a focus-triggered capture indicates a specific target application and narrows what was likely exposed.
* Locate and review captured images before they are exfiltrated or overwritten; they often show exactly what was compromised with no inference needed.
* Treat any content visible in a recovered capture (codes, balances, credentials) as exposed and act accordingly.
data.short_recommendation: Determine whether capture is timer- or focus-triggered; a focus trigger identifies the specific target application.

mitre_techniques.procedure: Captured the foreground window via PrintWindow whenever a banking-portal process gained focus.

mbc_techniques.implementation: Triggered a BitBlt screen capture on a timer and queued the resulting image for exfiltration.
